title: JumpCloud (API v1 and v2, API key of a Read Only administrator)
readScopes: The API key of a JumpCloud administrator who holds only the Read Only role (JUMPCLOUD_API_KEY, sent as x-api-key). API access is off for every new administrator; an Administrator with Billing turns it on (Settings > Administrators > Enable API access). The key carries its administrator's role.

checks.title: Every active user is enrolled in MFA (TOTP, Push or WebAuthn)
checks.scope: Users in state ACTIVATED and not suspended, from mfaEnrollment (overallStatus, totpStatus, pushStatus, webAuthnStatus) or else totp_enabled; staged and suspended users are counted in the detail, not judged.

checks.title: Every active user must use MFA on the User Portal
checks.scope: From each user's enable_user_portal_multifactor. Users without it are skipped, not failed, when an enabled User Portal authentication policy requires MFA, because the check does not resolve which user groups a policy covers.

checks.title: Every enabled allow authentication (conditional access) policy requires MFA
checks.scope: Policies not disabled and not monitor-only, with effect.action allow, of every type (User Portal, SSO applications, LDAP, Admin Portal); a policy that lets a trusted network sign in with a password alone fails. Skipped when no such policy exists. Default Access Policies, which apply when no conditional access policy does (SSO Applications and LDAP default to Allow authentication without MFA; jumpcloud.com/support/set-a-global-policy, read 2026-10-26), are not read: JumpCloud's API 2.0 OpenAPI file (Last-Modified 2026-10-26) declares /authn/policy/fallback/{resource_type} with a path parameter and no operation, and no JumpCloud SDK or CLI on GitHub calls it (rechecked 2026-10-26).

checks.title: MFA is required for every Admin Portal login
checks.scope: The organization setting requireAdminMFA. Admins who sign in with Google use the Google account's MFA instead, which is not visible here.

checks.title: Administrators are limited to --jumpcloud-max-admins accounts, every role counted
checks.scope: Every administrator linked to the organization, whatever the role, the collector's own Read Only account included; roles are not readable through the API.

checks.title: The organization's password policy sets a minimum length of --jumpcloud-min-password-length or more
checks.scope: The default policy in organization settings (passwordPolicy.enableMinLength and minLength); custom password policies for user groups are not listed by the API and are not judged.

checks.title: The organization's password policy locks an account after 1 to 10 failed attempts
checks.scope: The default policy (passwordPolicy.enableMaxLoginAttempts and maxLoginAttempts); lockoutTimeInSeconds is reported, not judged.

checks.title: Each device reports full disk encryption as active (FileVault or BitLocker)
checks.scope: Every device with the JumpCloud agent, one result per device, from fde.active; a device that does not report it is skipped.

checks.title: Each device runs an OS at or above the given minimum version
checks.scope: Every device, against --jumpcloud-min-os per platform (macos, windows, linux) from osVersionDetail or version; without that option the check is skipped. How Windows builds appear in osVersionDetail is not stated in the reference [Unverified].

checks.title: Each device has contacted JumpCloud within the last 14 days
checks.scope: Every device, from lastContact; the window is --jumpcloud-contact-days.
